name: Begum Rokeya
role: Pioneer of women’s education and reform in Bengal
contribution: She built institutions, wrote influential feminist texts, and argued that education was central to women’s emancipation.
context: Working within conservative colonial-era society, she combined literary critique with practical educational reform.
impact: Her ideas continue to shape gender justice discourse and educational aspirations in Bangladesh and Bengal.
highlight: She turned women’s education into a public question of justice.
